title: Mortgage Loan File Program Matrix: Credit Score, Loan-to-Value and Debt-to-Income Limits
content:
Every Mortgage Loan File at Larkspur Home Lending is underwritten under one of seven loan programs, and each program sets its own floor for the representative credit score and its own ceilings for base-loan-to-value and total debt-to-income. The figures below are the program limits that apply to a file opened under, or moved into, that program.

## Credit and leverage limits by program

| Program | Minimum representative credit score (FICO points) | Maximum base-loan-to-value, purchase | Maximum base-loan-to-value, rate-and-term refinance | Maximum base-loan-to-value, cash-out refinance | Maximum total debt-to-income |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 580 | 96.5% | 97.75% | 80.0% | 56.9% |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 600 | 100.0% | 100.0% | 90.0% | 60.0% |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 620 | 97.0% | 97.0% | 0.0% (cash-out is not an eligible purpose) | 50.0% |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 620 | 95.0% | 95.0% | 80.0% | 50.0% |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 620 | 95.0% | 95.0% | 80.0% | 50.0% |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 640 | 90.0% | 90.0% | 75.0% | 45.0% |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 700 | 85.0% | 80.0% | 70.0% | 43.0% |

Loan-to-value percentages are stated to 2 decimals; the credit score is a whole number of FICO points. The maximum that applies to a file is the one for the file's loan purpose: purchase, rate-and-term refinance or cash-out refinance.

## Program entry requirements

Each program also has the entry requirements below, stated as the program's own entry terms.

| Program | Entry requirements |
|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 580; purchase base-loan-to-value of at most 96.5%; occupancy as a primary residence; an FHA case number assigned |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 600; a VA certificate of eligibility; occupancy as a primary residence |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 620; income of at most 80 percent of area median income; occupancy as a primary residence |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 620; base loan amount of at most 832750.00 USD |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 620; base loan amount of at most 832750.00 USD; a loan term of 180 months |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 640; base loan amount from 832751.00 USD to 1249125.00 USD; property in a high-cost county |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | credit score of at least 700; base loan amount of at least 832751.00 USD; at least 12 months of reserves |

## Reading the table

- **Is a score equal to the minimum enough?** Yes. The score must be at or above the minimum, so a hypothetical file scoring exactly 620 meets the floor of the Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed program, while 619 does not.
- **Is a ratio equal to the maximum acceptable?** Yes. Base-loan-to-value and debt-to-income must be at or below the maximum. A hypothetical Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed purchase at exactly 85.00% base-loan-to-value is within the limit; 85.01% is not.
- **Does the same file face different loan-to-value ceilings?** Only by loan purpose. Under the Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed program a purchase may reach 85.0%, a rate-and-term refinance 80.0% and a cash-out refinance 70.0%.
